reviews.title: Not bad, can't wait to actually put them in a build one day.
reviews.comment:
While these look very nice, I also bought the 3 pack and intend for my case to have both the forward, this one completed my reverse set of 4 for the frontside and bottom intake. The unfortunate part is I won't be able to attest for in case performance with the fans until I have a full build together, and this current market has really grinded my first build to a halt. I'm intending to put these in a Darkflash C275p and swap aio fans to match the rest for this fish tank itx case. These feel solid, I connected them to a power supply with a manual fan controller just out of curiosity. Lighting is smooth and evenly diffused, I really like the modular design that snaps in and have a seamless look, though I do feel these could have a little more flexibility in term of orientated power connection so the wire can be flipped and hidden more easily through the cable routes for a cleaner look. The connecter itself isn't bad aside from that small nitpick. They seem to run decently quiet, though I don't have a decibal meter to personally test if the claims of >30 is true, but they're quiet enough and I don't plan to have these curved at full rpm anyway as well has intending to undervolt my future CPU to run at a cooler efficiency.
For the price this isn't bad especially on sale. I know someone who payed a bit more for some Lian Li fans, despite having the similar front angular design, these just look a bit cleaner to me aesthetically and they sound a little quieter.
Honestly, if asiahorse sold a 10-pack of Nyota ultra 120mm and 140mm fan options (6 reverse + 4 forwards) and included the Umbra Fan Hub in the box for about $130/140 I'd say it'd be a one and done deal as well as if an individual needs extras to buy separately for extras for a larger cases. Maybe if I ever get to doing a black build in the they'd have something like this and make it easier.
reviews.author: Nightweeb92

reviews.title: Awesome Fans!!!
reviews.comment: Love the look and being able to sync it all together is a plus. They lock in to each other and link into a single connection allowing you to have a cleaner look. Going to snag other set in standard to replace the aio fans (also by the same brand) to have a uniform look. I’d highly recommend them

reviews.title: Questionable QC
reviews.comment: These are decently nice fans, however, the idea is that these are marketed as premium fans. I really wasn’t impressed with the fit and finish of these fans. I reached out to the seller asking about this with no response. The rubber pads are very misaligned and you cannot fix them. Hard to ignore when you’re trying to build an asthetically pleasing PC.
